summary: MCP filesystem server: path prefix collision bypasses the allowed-directory check
details: In @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem before 0.6.4 (or 2025.7.01), the allowed-directory check compared path prefixes as strings, so a path such as /data/allowed_evil passed a check for /data/allowed. This let callers reach files outside the configured directories. Upgrade to 0.6.4 / 2025.7.01 or later.

database_specific.source: Public CVE record; not independently reproduced by Verfy.
